title: NDA Maths
summary: NDA Mathematics past questions, NDA 1 2017 to NDA 2 2026, five a day. Questions UPSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question. A set of linked items counts as one question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 19 papers, NDA 1 2017 to NDA 2 2026. UPSC rarely reprints a question word for word, so most of the order comes from question types. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_NDA.md) and checked in the main session.
